title: Sample: how to make an AI agent wait for a human yes
description: Sample post for local development: pausing an AI agent before a risky step until a person approves it on their phone.
tldr: A risky agent step should wait for a person to say yes.
A phone call gets an answer faster than a chat message.
Your software reads the answer and then continues or stops.
markdown:
Agents can now take real actions: send money, delete data, email customers. Some of those actions need a person to say yes first.

## What is a human approval step?

It is a pause in your agent. The agent stops before the risky action and asks one person to decide.

- The agent describes the action in one sentence.
- A person reads it and picks approve or reject.
- The agent continues only after a yes.

## Why does the phone need to ring?

A chat message can sit unread for hours. A ringing phone gets attention in seconds, even at night. [The M91 docs](https://m91.msg91.com/llms.txt) describe how the alert rings until someone answers.

## How does the answer get back to the agent?

Your code waits for the decision, then acts on it.

This command checks the decision for one alert:

```bash
./m91.sh decision --phone 919876543210 --custom-id deploy-42
```

| Answer | What the agent does |
| --- | --- |
| Approve | Runs the step |
| Reject | Skips the step and logs why |

## What should I try first?

Pick one risky step, add the pause, and test it with your own phone.

### What if nobody answers?

Decide a timeout and a safe default, such as "do nothing".

## What to do next

[Try M91: send your first alert in a few minutes.](https://m91.msg91.com/)
